resolutions.resolution_route_used: Repo protein states (D ratio 0.51) vs published zebrafish BMP gradient dynamics literature via OpenAlex
resolutions.evidence: Registered prior: free-diffusion D_chordin/D_mature-BMP2b=0.51 violates D_inh/D_act>1. Published zebrafish work treats BMP gradient formation as Chordin-mediated shuttling/transport rather than free differential diffusion: 'Dynamics of BMP signaling and distribution during zebrafish dorsal-ventral patterning' (2017, doi:10.7554/eLife.25861); cnidarian-to-vertebrate shuttling conservation reviewed in 'Chordin-mediated BMP shuttling patterns the secondary body axis' (2025, doi:10.1126/sciadv.adu6347). No literature supports patterning by 0.51-ratio free diffusion.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: as_predicted — current_plus_public_sources (conf 0.60): public literature decided it; repo alone could only state the prior.

resolutions.resolution_route_used: UniProt O57472 tolloid-cleavage PTM comment (in sidecar) vs ZFIN tolloid/minifin phenotype class and BMP-Chordin literature
resolutions.evidence: Tolloid/Minifin loss in zebrafish is a classic dorsalized mutant class (BMP signalling reduced when Chordin cannot be cleaved/released), matching the registered direction: more intact Chordin -> contracted BMP/pSmad activity -> dorsalization. Consistent with the chordin-cleavage literature surfaced via OpenAlex (e.g. doi:10.1242/dev.01577 on Chordin-dependent BMP regulation). No report of tolloid loss causing ventralization was found.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: as_predicted — current_plus_public_sources (conf 0.85): ZFIN/literature phenotype lookup sufficed.

resolutions.resolution_route_used: UniProt Q92008 dual lipidation (sidecar) vs zebrafish Hedgehog lipidation literature via OpenAlex
resolutions.evidence: Lipidation is functional in zebrafish Shh signalling: 'New chemical probes targeting cholesterylation of Sonic Hedgehog in human cells and zebrafish' (2014, doi:10.1039/C4SC01600A), and dual-lipid release biology reviewed in doi:10.1002/bies.202100133. Bound established: wild-type ShhNp is dually lipidated and tethered (repo state), and cholesterylation is required for normal signalling in zebrafish. NOT established from sources extracted: the specific registered gradient-shape claim (distal ptc-domain expansion + reduced near-source peak upon lipidation loss) in a zebrafish tissue assay. Missing data: paired ptc1/ptc2 domain measurements for lipidation-perturbed vs wild-type zebrafish Shh.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: harder_than_predicted — expected a public-source decision at conf 0.70; the lipidation fact resolved, the gradient-shape outcome did not, so this row joins the partial set.

resolutions.resolution_route_used: Dataset law S=u*T + somitogenesis literature search (OpenAlex) for paired period/somite measurements
resolutions.evidence: Bound established: the proportional architecture (clock period sets somite size at a given wavefront speed) is the standard, literature-supported segmentation-clock framework (zebrafish clock-mechanism studies, e.g. doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.0050150; core-circuit dynamics doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.1001364). NOT established: a paired dataset (measured T change + measured S change, wavefront controlled) sufficient to test the registered x0.80/x0.90/x1.10/x1.20 multipliers within 5 points. Missing data: paired her1-period and somite-length measurements under a controlled-wavefront perturbation, tabulated in one source.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: as_predicted — registered partial_only (conf 0.55); public data bound it but did not decide it, exactly as forecast.
